claims.content: The Customer has a confirmed bid in the system: a bid was successfully placed and confirmed via the 'Bid Confirmation Popup DIV' overlay (confirming the SmartBid amount and credit card details).

The confirmed bid is recorded in the Customer's bid records as a current/winning bid, represented by Winning Bid or Max Bid (SmartBid) in the Customer's current-bid and bid-history data, and the auction must be active/live at the time of the retraction attempt.
There are no successful postconditions for this use case. The system enforces a strict no-cancellation policy, so a confirmed bid cannot be retracted; the bid remains confirmed and active.
